messages:
auditor_smith: Quick request: need evidence package for a recent RBAC change (service-account -> role binding) plus the KMS key provenance and rotation history. Prefer a tamper-evident export + a 5-7min recorded walkthrough showing how you tied the RBAC event to downstream API calls. Sampling window: last 30 days.

lina (Security): Thanks. Can you confirm scope: entire org or just the infra AWS account where the change landed? Also indicate whether you need raw events or a redacted zip.

auditor_smith: Infra account only is fine. Redacted bundle OK but must retain key IDs, request_ids, and timestamps. We want a signed manifest (notarized) and the queries used to pull evidence.

tom (Infra): Plan: pull auth-server audit index for role.bind events, apigw for request traces, and cloudtrail + kms-audit for KMS operations. I'll produce a notarized bundle using our internal "evidence-collector" which supports sigstore signing. Steps: 1) export events, 2) apply redaction rules, 3) sign bundle + attestation.

lina (Security): For HSM attestation the vendor offers an exportable attestation PDF or an API to request a signed statement. Legal prefers the PDF. If vendor delays, we can include a timestamped console dump plus the vendor support ticket.

auditor_smith: PDF preferred. Console dump ok temporarily but mark it as interim.

tom (Infra): Example KQL/Splunk queries I'll attach in README: ```
// auth-server
index=auth_audit "role.bind" earliest=-30d | fields _time, actor, service_account, role, request_id
// apigw traces
index=apigw request_id=* earliest=-30d | search service_account=<svc-123> | fields _time, request_id, path, status
// kms
index=kms-audit eventName=CreateKey OR eventName=RotateKey OR eventName=GenerateDataKey earliest=-30d | fields _time, userIdentity, kmsKeyId, eventName
```

lina (Security): evidence-collector bundle command (example): ```
./evidence-collector export \\n  --indexes auth_audit,apigw,kms-audit \\n  --filter "service_account=svc-123 AND _time>=now-30d" \\n  --redact rules/redact.json \\n  --output /tmp/rbac_kms_bundle.tar.gz
# sign with sigstore
cosign sign-blob --key /opt/keys/compliance.cosign /tmp/rbac_kms_bundle.tar.gz > /tmp/rbac_kms_bundle.sig
sha256sum /tmp/rbac_kms_bundle.tar.gz > /tmp/rbac_kms_bundle.sha256
```

compliance-bot: Note: all exports automatically generate a compliance-audit event and are retained 90 days. If PII is present, include the redaction manifest in the bundle.

tom (Infra): Redaction plan: remove emails, IPs, full API keys. Replace with hashed identifiers. Keep request_id, timestamp, role names, and kmsKeyId untouched. We'll include a redaction map file.

lina (Security): For correlation we'll include a small script in the bundle that links events by request_id and shows the sequence: role.bind -> KMS GenerateDataKey -> apigw call. Example (Python): ```
# correlate.py (very small)
import json
# loads events, build index by request_id, print timeline
```

auditor_smith: Good — include that script and the exact commands/queries in README. Also need the signing key fingerprint and the sigstore certificate chain used to sign the bundle.

lina (Security): We'll include cosign certificate, subject, and fingerprint. Also include the checksum and a signed manifest.

tom (Infra): ETA: I can upload redacted bundle + README + recording by tomorrow EOD. Will supply presigned S3 link + sha256 and cosign output in this thread.

scheduler-bot: Reminder: compliance-walkthrough scheduled 2026-03-03 09:00 PST (recording enabled) hosted by lina (Security).

auditor_smith: Thanks — please flag if vendor attestation PDF is delayed so we can accept the interim artifact. If possible, note whether HSM attestation includes module serial/firmware version.

lina (Security): Will ask vendor for serial + firmware in the PDF. If we only get console export we'll include those fields in the screenshot and the ticket id.

tom (Infra): I'll post the bundle link and manifest here once complete.

auditor_smith: Appreciated. :thumbsup:
